name: them’s swordfighting words!
source:
Brande (pronounced brand-ee) is the best fencer in the entire Holy Union.She's the cream of the crop, the cutting edge. She's the one who will win the championship and earn the right to slay the feral god under their lands--The Almighty Opponent.

But when her ex-rival Jaya returns from her years-long mission abroad, Brande's destined victory starts to come into question.

[From [url=https://thetrixiestwords.itch.io/thems-swordfighting-words]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
布兰德（发音为brand-ee）是整个神圣联盟中最好的击剑手。她是百里挑一，最前沿。她将赢得冠军，并获得在他们的土地上杀死野神——全能对手的权利。

但当她的前对手贾亚结束多年的海外任务归来时，布兰德注定的胜利开始受到质疑。

[来自[url=https://thetrixiestwords.itch.io/thems-swordfighting-words]itch.io[/url]]
